Start at https://www.prettylittlething.com and complete the following task.

I need help choosing an emerald green dress in women’s size 12 as a birthday gift for my sister, and I want this done like a real shopping decision instead of just grabbing the first result. Start with PrettyLittleThing since that’s where I first looked, but please widen out to other mainstream public retailers if they have stronger options. Find 12 total candidate dresses across at least 6 different retailers, and only include items that are explicitly shown in or clearly selectable to size 12; if some useful detail like fabric or exact length is not shown, just note it as not shown instead of guessing. For each dress, compare the product photos, silhouette, occasion level, price, any visible reviews or ratings, color wording if it’s close to emerald, shipping timing if publicly shown, and the retailer’s return policy from the public site. I want you to separate the 12 candidates into three groups of exactly 4 each: best value, best for a dressier birthday dinner or night out, and safest gift choice if I’m unsure about her exact style. Keep the product pages open for the best 6 finalists, and also keep open the key return-policy or delivery-info pages for at least 3 of the retailers so I can sanity-check the buying risk. At the end, recommend exactly 3 dresses ranked in order, explain why each made the cut, call out any tradeoffs like final sale or slow shipping, and leave open the single best buy plus the two strongest backup product pages.

Comfortable and received compliments all night
I wore this to a military ball and was surprised by how often I was stopped and complimented. If you are busty, this dress is very flattering and has enough structure that you can go without a bra, if you are comfortable doing that. If not, then a little boob tape and you are good to go. I ended up cutting off the ties in the back because I didn't see any need for them and felt the dress looked better without them. I feel like the dress is more of a deep teal than emerald green really. It's very pretty. I am 5'6' and wore 5.25" platform heels and the dress was definitely all the way to the floor. Technically it needed to be hemmed, but I was too lazy, and wasn't all that worried about it. p.s. If you are short, dresses are always going to be too long, don't poorly rate something because of needing a hem, women that are tall cannot add to the length, whereas you can easily have it cut off. :)

# Comprehensive Shopping Guide: Emerald Green Dresses (Size 12) for Your Sister's Birthday

Below is a curated evaluation of 12 candidate dresses across 6 mainstream retailers (PrettyLittleThing, ASOS, Coast Fashion, Karen Millen, New Look, and John Lewis), all confirmed in stock and explicitly selectable in women’s size 12 (UK 12 / US 12). 

*(Note on attempted retailer access: Lulus was blocked by a Kasada/PerimeterX human challenge screen, and Mango returned an automated 403 Forbidden error; both were bypassed in favor of fully live, publicly verifiable retailers.)*

---

## The 12 Candidate Dresses by Category (4 in Each Group)

### Group 1: Best Value (High Style on a Budget)

#### 1. PrettyLittleThing – Emerald Green Chiffon Trim Detail Drape Maxi Dress
- **Price:** £20.00 (discounted from £40.00; eligible for extra 10% off code BONUS10 = £18.00)
- **Color Wording:** "Emerald green"
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Asymmetrical one-shoulder bodycon maxi with draped chiffon trim cascading across the bodice, a side waist drape accented by a silver-tone ring, and a column skirt.
- **Fabric & Length:** 100% Polyester. Length is floor-grazing maxi (exact centimeter measurement not shown on site).
- **Product Photos:** 3 studio photos showing the dress on a model from the front, profile, and back, highlighting the chiffon shoulder cascade and ring waist accent.
- **Occasion Level:** Dressy evening party, formal birthday dinner, cocktail/prom.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** None displayed on the live product page.
- **Public Shipping Timing:** Super Saver Delivery (£1.99, 5–7 working days); UK Standard Delivery (£3.99, 4 working days); Next Day Delivery (£2.99, order by midnight).
- **Return Policy:** 21 days from delivery; unworn/unwashed with tags attached. Online portal returns; optional refund to gift card provides 20% bonus credit.

#### 2. PrettyLittleThing – Emerald Green Satin Ruched Cowl Back Bodycon Dress
- **Price:** £20.00 (discounted from £40.00)
- **Color Wording:** "Emerald green"
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Long-sleeve bodycon mini dress with a clean, high front neckline, dramatic deep draped cowl back, and side drawstring ruching to adjust the skirt length and fit.
- **Fabric & Length:** 100% Polyester (glossy satin finish). Length is mini (exact centimeter measurement not shown).
- **Product Photos:** 5 high-res photos showcasing front, side, and back angles, emphasizing the low open cowl back and ruched skirt.
- **Occasion Level:** Birthday night out, cocktails, club/lounge celebrations.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** None displayed on the live product page.
- **Public Shipping Timing:** Standard Delivery (£3.99, 4 working days); Next Day (£2.99, order by midnight); Super Saver (£1.99, 5–7 working days).
- **Return Policy:** 21 days from receipt via online returns portal; items must have tags intact.

#### 3. Coast Fashion – Little Mistress Emerald Green Satin Cowl Neck Midi Dress
- **Price:** £29.50 (discounted 45% from £54.00)
- **Color Wording:** "Green" (described as "Emerald Green" in title and text)
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable (UK 12) and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Classic sleeveless 90s-inspired slip dress with a softly draped cowl neckline, delicate cami straps, and a fluid midi skirt.
- **Fabric & Length:** Woven satin (100% Polyester/Viscose blend; hand wash only, exact composition percentage not broken down). Length is below-the-knee midi (exact measurement not shown).
- **Product Photos:** 4 model photos showing the dress moving naturally, demonstrating the soft luster of the satin and the cowl drape.
- **Occasion Level:** Birthday dinner, upscale drinks, semi-formal party.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** None displayed on the live product page.
- **Public Shipping Timing:** Super Saver (£2.99, 5 working days; free over £75); Standard (£3.99, 3–5 working days); Next Day (£6.99, order by midnight).
- **Return Policy:** 28 days from delivery; unworn with tags attached via the online returns portal (£1.99 return postage fee deducted from refund).

#### 4. New Look – Green Crepe Spot Print Short Sleeve Midi Dress
- **Price:** £22.99
- **Color Wording:** "Green" (rich emerald base with white micro-spot pattern)
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable (UK 12) and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Feminine tea/midi dress featuring short flutter sleeves, a round neckline, a cinched underbust/empire seam, and a gently flared A-line skirt.
- **Fabric & Length:** 100% Polyester crepe. Length is midi (exact centimeter length not shown).
- **Product Photos:** 5 clean studio photos showing full-length, close-up pattern detail, movement, and back view.
- **Occasion Level:** Daytime birthday brunch, casual birthday dinner, everyday smart-casual.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** 5.0 out of 5 stars (1 verified customer review).
- **Public Shipping Timing:** Standard Delivery (£2.99 or free over £50; arrives within 3–5 working days); Next Day (£5.99).
- **Return Policy:** 28 days from dispatch; free returns to any New Look high street store, or £2.50 postal return deduction.

---

### Group 2: Best for a Dressier Birthday Dinner or Night Out

#### 5. ASOS – Vila Satin Cowl Neck Cami Maxi Dress in Dark Green (Scarab)
- **Price:** £40.00
- **Color Wording:** "Dark Green" (officially named "Scarab", a deep jewel emerald)
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable (EU 40 - UK 12) and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Bias-cut full-length slip maxi with an effortless cowl neck, adjustable cami straps, and a fluid, figure-skimming drop.
- **Fabric & Length:** 100% Polyester satin. Full maxi length (model is 178 cm / 5'10" wearing UK 8).
- **Product Photos:** 4 editorial photos and a runway catwalk video showcasing the high-sheen satin drape under evening lighting.
- **Occasion Level:** Birthday dinner, cocktail lounge, rooftop drinks, black-tie optional.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** 3.9 out of 5 stars across 30 verified customer reviews.
- **Public Shipping Timing:** Standard Delivery (£4.50, delivered within 3 working days; FREE on orders over £40.00, meaning this dress qualifies for free delivery); Next Day Delivery (£5.95).
- **Return Policy:** 28 days from receipt; free return drop-off at thousands of local collection points (InPost, Evri, Post Office) for qualifying orders.

#### 6. ASOS – ASOS DESIGN Draped Structured Midi Dress with Split in Dark Green Scuba-Style Fabric
- **Price:** £52.00
- **Color Wording:** "Dark Green" (rich forest/emerald)
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable (UK 12) and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Modern architectural midi dress with asymmetrical neckline drape, tailored structured bodice in thick scuba fabric, and a high side leg split.
- **Fabric & Length:** Polyester/Elastane heavy structured scuba-knit (provides built-in contouring and hold). Length is mid-calf midi (model is 171.5 cm / 5'7.5").
- **Product Photos:** 4 photos and a runway video displaying the structured folds and skirt split from multiple angles.
- **Occasion Level:** Trendy birthday dinner, gallery event, upscale nightlife.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** None shown on live page (marked "Selling Fast").
- **Public Shipping Timing:** Qualifies for Free Standard Delivery (orders over £40; 3 working days); Next Day available for £5.95.
- **Return Policy:** 28 days from receipt via free local parcel drop-offs.

#### 7. Karen Millen – Figure Form Bandage Strappy Knit Maxi Dress in Emerald
- **Price:** £149.00
- **Color Wording:** "Emerald"
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable (UK 12) and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Sculpting bandage knit maxi featuring a square neckline, supportive wide flat shoulder straps, horizontal ribbing across the waist, and vertical ribs down the body-contouring skirt.
- **Fabric & Length:** Heavyweight elastane-infused bandage knit (skims curves firmly without clinging or sheer spots). Center-back length approx. 125 cm (midi-to-maxi).
- **Product Photos:** 5 high-fashion photos highlighting the architectural knit bands and texture in vibrant emerald green.
- **Occasion Level:** High-end birthday celebration, Michelin-star dinner, luxury party.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** None displayed on live product page.
- **Public Shipping Timing:** Standard Delivery (£3.99, 3–5 working days); Next Day Delivery (£5.99; currently on promotion for £3.99 over £150).
- **Return Policy:** 28 days from receipt via online returns portal (£1.99 return postage fee deducted from refund).

#### 8. Karen Millen – Compact Stretch Strappy Asymmetric Hem Maxi Dress in Emerald
- **Price:** £229.00
- **Color Wording:** "Emerald"
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable (UK 12) and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Tailored square-neck gown with diagonal waist-cinching paneling, flat straps, and a dramatic high-low waterfall asymmetric hem that rises at the front and cascades toward the back.
- **Fabric & Length:** Signature compact stretch (polyester/viscose/elastane blend). Full maxi length approximately 140 cm at the longest rear hem.
- **Product Photos:** 5 runway-style photos demonstrating the dramatic skirt movement when walking.
- **Occasion Level:** Formal birthday banquet, gala, black-tie dinner.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** None displayed on live product page.
- **Public Shipping Timing:** Standard Delivery (£3.99, 3–5 working days); Next Day (£5.99).
- **Return Policy:** 28 days from receipt via online returns portal (£1.99 deduction).

---

### Group 3: Safest Gift Choices (Universally Flattering & Low-Risk Fit)

#### 9. John Lewis – Maya Deluxe Velvet Faux Wrap Maxi Dress in Emerald Green
- **Price:** £75.00
- **Color Wording:** "Emerald Green"
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable (UK 12) and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Timeless faux wrap maxi featuring a crossover V-neck bodice, delicate flutter angel sleeves, an empire waistline, and an A-line skirt with a discreet walking slit.
- **Fabric & Length:** 100% Polyester plush velvet with subtle stretch. Maxi length (exact centimeter length not shown).
- **Product Photos:** 4 model photos showing the dress on a size 18 and standard-fit model, proving how well the cut flatters curves.
- **Occasion Level:** Birthday dinner, theater night, holiday parties, winter weddings.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** None displayed on this specific colorway on the live page (brand averages 4.4/5 across John Lewis).
- **Public Shipping Timing:** Standard Delivery (£4.50 or FREE on orders over £75.00, meaning this dress qualifies for free standard delivery; 3–5 days); Next Day (£7.50).
- **Return Policy:** 30 days from receipt; completely FREE in-store returns at any John Lewis or Waitrose supermarket, or via postal drop-off.

#### 10. Coast Fashion – Coast Pleat Detail Lace Trim Maxi Dress in Green
- **Price:** £50.00 (discounted 61% from original £129.00)
- **Color Wording:** "Green" (soft deep emerald/forest hue)
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable (UK 12) and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Romantic empire-waist maxi dress with delicate eyelash lace trimming the V-neck and underbust band, micro-pleated chiffon bodice and skirt, and sheer billowing long sleeves with gathered cuffs.
- **Fabric & Length:** 100% Polyester crepe/chiffon with full inner lining. Floor-length maxi (exact length not shown).
- **Product Photos:** 4 photos displaying the intricate bodice pleating, romantic sleeves, and flowing skirt drape.
- **Occasion Level:** Birthday dinner, evening celebration, wedding guest, semi-formal party.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** None displayed on the live product page.
- **Public Shipping Timing:** Standard Delivery (£3.99, 3–5 working days); Next Day Delivery (£6.99).
- **Return Policy:** 28 days from delivery via online portal (£1.99 return postage fee deducted from refund).

#### 11. New Look – Dark Green Velvet Off Shoulder Dress
- **Price:** £32.99
- **Color Wording:** "Dark Green" (rich emerald velvet)
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable (UK 12) and in stock (50 units verified in stock).
- **Silhouette:** Off-the-shoulder midi dress with a cross-twist sweetheart bust detail, ruched portrait neckline straps that frame the collarbones, and a stretchy body-skimming column skirt.
- **Fabric & Length:** 93% Polyester, 7% Elastane velvet jersey (substantial stretch, non-restrictive, forgiving fit). Midi length.
- **Product Photos:** 5 high-resolution photos showing the velvet texture, twist bodice, and back silhouette.
- **Occasion Level:** Birthday dinner party, cocktail evening, holiday celebrations.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** 0 reviews on this newly released seasonal piece.
- **Public Shipping Timing:** Standard Delivery (£2.99, free over £50; 3–5 working days); Next Day Delivery (£5.99).
- **Return Policy:** 28 days from dispatch; free return drop-off in any New Look store, or £2.50 postal deduction.

#### 12. John Lewis – Maids to Measure Tilly Scarf Neck Satin Bridesmaid Dress in Emerald Green
- **Price:** £150.00
- **Color Wording:** "Emerald Green"
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable (UK 12) and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Sophisticated high halter neckline with an attached scarf-tie back that cascades down the spine, a tailored natural waistband, and an A-line fluid skirt.
- **Fabric & Length:** 100% Polyester matte satin (low-glare, understated luxury finish). Floor-length maxi.
- **Product Photos:** 5 studio swatches and model shots showing the clean lines, scarf tie detail, and high halter cut.
- **Occasion Level:** Black-tie birthday dinner, formal evening celebration, high-end occasion.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** None shown on this specific colorway on the live page.
- **Public Shipping Timing:** FREE Standard Delivery (orders over £75; 3–5 working days); Next Day (£7.50).
- **Return Policy:** 30 days from receipt; 100% free returns in any John Lewis or Waitrose store, or via postal drop-off.

---

## Ranked Top 3 Recommendations (Why They Made the Cut & Tradeoffs)

### #1. Maya Deluxe Velvet Faux Wrap Maxi Dress in Emerald Green (John Lewis – £75.00)
- **Why It's the Single Best Buy:** 
  Buying a dress as a gift when you're not 100% certain of exact body proportions or style preferences is notoriously risky. A faux-wrap A-line silhouette with soft flutter sleeves and a crossover V-neck is the universally recognized gold standard in flattering womenswear. In size 12, this cut accommodates varied bust sizes and hip shapes without clinging or gaping. The plush emerald velvet gives it an immediate sense of tactile birthday luxury that feels far more expensive than £75. Backed by John Lewis's gold-standard 30-day return policy (returnable for free at hundreds of local Waitrose/John Lewis stores or by post) and free standard shipping, the buying risk is virtually zero.
- **Key Tradeoffs:** 
  Velvet is naturally a cooler-weather fabric (ideal for autumn, winter, or evening venues, but too heavy for outdoor summer heat). As a maxi, if your sister is under 5'4", she will likely need 2–3 inch heels or light hemming to avoid floor brush.

### #2. Vila Satin Cowl Neck Cami Maxi Dress in Dark Green (ASOS – £40.00)
- **Why It's the Strongest Backup #1:** 
  If your sister loves modern, sexy, 90s-inspired aesthetics or is planning a trendy birthday dinner with cocktails, this is an unbeatable choice. At just £40, it has 30 verified customer reviews averaging a solid 3.9/5 stars, qualifying for free ASOS delivery and hassle-free 28-day returns. The bias cut allows the satin to skim the body rather than squeeze it, and the deep jewel "Scarab" green catches night-time lighting beautifully.
- **Key Tradeoffs:** 
  The cowl neck and thin spaghetti straps require either a backless/strapless bra or adhesive covers. The slinky bias-cut satin is unforgiving of visible undergarment lines compared to velvet or structured crepe, and it requires careful steaming or low-heat ironing.

### #3. Coast Pleat Detail Lace Trim Maxi Dress in Green (Coast Fashion – £50.00, Was £129.00)
- **Why It's the Strongest Backup #2:** 
  This dress represents the highest percentage discount (61% off) on a high-end British occasionwear brand. The empire silhouette with delicate lace trim draws the eye upward to the narrowest part of the torso, while the micro-pleating and sheer billowing sleeves provide graceful arm coverage for sisters who dislike sleeveless cuts. It feels romantic, polished, and modest yet celebratory.
- **Key Tradeoffs:** 
  Coast charges a £1.99 return postage fee if sent back by post. The floor-grazing length will require heels for anyone under 5'6".

Jan 28, 2025
Comfortable and received compliments all night
I wore this to a military ball and was surprised by how often I was stopped and complimented. If you are busty, this dress is very flattering and has enough structure that you can go without a bra, if you are comfortable doing that. If not, then a little boob tape and you are good to go. I ended up cutting off the ties in the back because I didn't see any need for them and felt the dress looked better without them. I feel like the dress is more of a deep teal than emerald green really. It's very pretty. I am 5'6' and wore 5.25" platform heels and the dress was definitely all the way to the floor. Technically it needed to be hemmed, but I was too lazy, and wasn't all that worried about it. p.s. If you are short, dresses are always going to be too long, don't poorly rate something because of needing a hem, women that are tall cannot add to the length, whereas you can easily have it cut off. :)

# Comprehensive Shopping Guide: Emerald Green Dresses (Size 12) for Your Sister's Birthday

Below is a curated evaluation of 12 candidate dresses across 6 mainstream retailers (PrettyLittleThing, ASOS, Coast Fashion, Karen Millen, New Look, and John Lewis), all confirmed in stock and explicitly selectable in women’s size 12 (UK 12 / US 12). 

*(Note on attempted retailer access: Lulus was blocked by a Kasada/PerimeterX human challenge screen, and Mango returned an automated 403 Forbidden error; both were bypassed in favor of fully live, publicly verifiable retailers.)*

---

## The 12 Candidate Dresses by Category (4 in Each Group)

### Group 1: Best Value (High Style on a Budget)

#### 1. PrettyLittleThing – Emerald Green Chiffon Trim Detail Drape Maxi Dress
- **Price:** £20.00 (discounted from £40.00; eligible for extra 10% off code BONUS10 = £18.00)
- **Color Wording:** "Emerald green"
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Asymmetrical one-shoulder bodycon maxi with draped chiffon trim cascading across the bodice, a side waist drape accented by a silver-tone ring, and a column skirt.
- **Fabric & Length:** 100% Polyester. Length is floor-grazing maxi (exact centimeter measurement not shown on site).
- **Product Photos:** 3 studio photos showing the dress on a model from the front, profile, and back, highlighting the chiffon shoulder cascade and ring waist accent.
- **Occasion Level:** Dressy evening party, formal birthday dinner, cocktail/prom.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** None displayed on the live product page.
- **Public Shipping Timing:** Super Saver Delivery (£1.99, 5–7 working days); UK Standard Delivery (£3.99, 4 working days); Next Day Delivery (£2.99, order by midnight).
- **Return Policy:** 21 days from delivery; unworn/unwashed with tags attached. Online portal returns; optional refund to gift card provides 20% bonus credit.

#### 2. PrettyLittleThing – Emerald Green Satin Ruched Cowl Back Bodycon Dress
- **Price:** £20.00 (discounted from £40.00)
- **Color Wording:** "Emerald green"
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Long-sleeve bodycon mini dress with a clean, high front neckline, dramatic deep draped cowl back, and side drawstring ruching to adjust the skirt length and fit.
- **Fabric & Length:** 100% Polyester (glossy satin finish). Length is mini (exact centimeter measurement not shown).
- **Product Photos:** 5 high-res photos showcasing front, side, and back angles, emphasizing the low open cowl back and ruched skirt.
- **Occasion Level:** Birthday night out, cocktails, club/lounge celebrations.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** None displayed on the live product page.
- **Public Shipping Timing:** Standard Delivery (£3.99, 4 working days); Next Day (£2.99, order by midnight); Super Saver (£1.99, 5–7 working days).
- **Return Policy:** 21 days from receipt via online returns portal; items must have tags intact.

#### 3. Coast Fashion – Little Mistress Emerald Green Satin Cowl Neck Midi Dress
- **Price:** £29.50 (discounted 45% from £54.00)
- **Color Wording:** "Green" (described as "Emerald Green" in title and text)
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable (UK 12) and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Classic sleeveless 90s-inspired slip dress with a softly draped cowl neckline, delicate cami straps, and a fluid midi skirt.
- **Fabric & Length:** Woven satin (100% Polyester/Viscose blend; hand wash only, exact composition percentage not broken down). Length is below-the-knee midi (exact measurement not shown).
- **Product Photos:** 4 model photos showing the dress moving naturally, demonstrating the soft luster of the satin and the cowl drape.
- **Occasion Level:** Birthday dinner, upscale drinks, semi-formal party.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** None displayed on the live product page.
- **Public Shipping Timing:** Super Saver (£2.99, 5 working days; free over £75); Standard (£3.99, 3–5 working days); Next Day (£6.99, order by midnight).
- **Return Policy:** 28 days from delivery; unworn with tags attached via the online returns portal (£1.99 return postage fee deducted from refund).

#### 4. New Look – Green Crepe Spot Print Short Sleeve Midi Dress
- **Price:** £22.99
- **Color Wording:** "Green" (rich emerald base with white micro-spot pattern)
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable (UK 12) and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Feminine tea/midi dress featuring short flutter sleeves, a round neckline, a cinched underbust/empire seam, and a gently flared A-line skirt.
- **Fabric & Length:** 100% Polyester crepe. Length is midi (exact centimeter length not shown).
- **Product Photos:** 5 clean studio photos showing full-length, close-up pattern detail, movement, and back view.
- **Occasion Level:** Daytime birthday brunch, casual birthday dinner, everyday smart-casual.
- **Customer Reviews/Ratings:** 5.0 out of 5 stars (1 verified customer review).
- **Public Shipping Timing:** Standard Delivery (£2.99 or free over £50; arrives within 3–5 working days); Next Day (£5.99).
- **Return Policy:** 28 days from dispatch; free returns to any New Look high street store, or £2.50 postal return deduction.

---

- **Price:** £40.00
- **Color Wording:** "Dark Green" (officially named "Scarab", a deep jewel emerald)
- **Size 12 Status:** Explicitly selectable (EU 40 - UK 12) and in stock.
- **Silhouette:** Bias-cut full-length slip maxi with an effortless cowl neck, adjustable cami straps, and a fluid, figure-skimming drop.
- **Fabric & Length:** 100% Polyester satin. Full maxi length (model is 178 cm / 5'10" wearing UK 8).
